card.name: Partway through foreign or rare words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long words from non-English text, such as Lao script, German, or Malay. It also fires inside split drug names like donepezil or sofosbuvir.

modes.label: Split drug names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug brand or generic names.
